q2_gaps: event extent measured in a non-temporal unit ("stopped Joey DeJohn in five rounds") — the duration Measure the instruction set defines assumes a time unit convertible to canonical seconds ("for three hours", "lasted two days"), and no form is given for an "in N <non-time-unit>" extent, nor for distinguishing that extent reading from an "in the fifth round" time-point reading
notes: "but" correctly yields the surface-headed binary (But sk_lose_1 sk_stop_1) in surface order, and both multi-word names are single opaque symbols with one Name atom each. "lost Vinnie Rossano" is parsed as a plain transitive with a Theme object, which is faithful to the words as written even though the intended sports sense is likely "lost to".
